page.title: Tenant Management
page.notAvailableBody: Tenant Management is for tenant admins and platform admins. Your role cannot list or manage members.
page.chooseTenantBody: Members are tenant-scoped. Sign in with an active tenant to manage members, groups, and roles.

errors.partialGroupSave_one: Some group changes were applied before the save failed ({{count}} change was applied). {{message}} Review the member's groups and try again.
errors.partialGroupSave_other: Some group changes were applied before the save failed ({{count}} changes were applied). {{message}} Review the member's groups and try again.

members.empty: No members in this tenant yet.

addMember.title: Add Member
addMember.pickUserHint: Pick an existing shared-realm user. This is not an email invitation.
addMember.chooseGroupsHint: Choose which groups to add this member to.

rename.title: Edit Tenant
rename.hint: The alias stays the same. Only the display name changes.

removeMember.title: Remove member
removeMember.description: Remove {{name}} from this tenant? They will lose group memberships here.

memberGroups.title: Member groups
memberGroups.hint: Effective roles come from these groups. There is no separate member-role editor.
memberGroups.empty: No groups in this tenant yet.

groups.empty: No groups in this tenant yet.
groups.alreadyExists: Group '{{name}}' already exists in this tenant.
groups.createRolesWarning: {{message}} Use Roles on the group row to retry.
groups.partialRolesSave: {{applied}} of {{total}} role changes were saved before the error. {{message}}

create.title: Add group
create.hint: People stay in the tenant if you later delete the group. Roles come from the group, not from a separate member-role editor.
create.rolesHint: Assign now so members of this group get their effective roles straight away. You can change these later from the group's Roles dialog.

renameDialog.title: Rename group
renameDialog.hint: Members stay in the group. The name must match the API rules.

deleteDialog.title: Delete group
deleteDialog.description: Delete {{name}}? People stay in the tenant. Roles that came only from this group go away.

rolesDialog.title: Group roles
rolesDialog.hint: Members of {{name}} get these as effective roles. A group may map more than one role.

errors.copyUnavailable: Copying is not available in this browser. Select the invitation URL to copy it.
errors.copyFailed: The invitation URL could not be copied. Select the URL to copy it manually.

invite.title: Invite User
invite.devLinkHint: Email is not configured, so share this single-use link. It uses the Accept invitation path, not this admin panel.
invite.formHint: Email a new person to join this tenant. If they already have an account, use Add Member instead.

errors.groupNameTooLong: Group name must be {{max}} characters or fewer
errors.groupNameInvalid: Group name can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and underscores, and must start and end with a letter or number
